An
Ordinance further to amend the Frontier
Murderous

[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September, 20011
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made
by the Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Frontier Murderous Outrages (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 4 of Regulation IV of 1901

general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section
4 of Regulation IV of 1901.‑‑In the
Balochistan Frontier Murderous Outrages Regulation, 1901, in sub section (1) of
section 4, for the words "Deputy Commissioner" wherever occurring the
word "Magistrate" shall be substituted.
